description: This file contains utility functions for handling E1AP protocol messages, including extracting cause strings, message type strings, transaction IDs, and UE IDs from various E1AP message structures.

methods.name: get_cause_str
methods.description: Returns a string describing the cause of an E1AP error based on cause type.

methods.name: get_message_type_str
methods.description: Returns a string literal representing the message type of an E1AP PDU.

methods.name: get_transaction_id
methods.description: Extracts the transaction ID from various E1AP message structures.

methods.name: get_gnb_cu_cp_ue_e1ap_id
methods.description: Retrieves the gnb_cu_cp_ue_e1ap_id from different E1AP message types.

methods.name: get_gnb_cu_up_ue_e1ap_id
methods.description: Retrieves the gnb_cu_up_ue_e1ap_id from different E1AP message types.
